description: Defines a SwiftUI view for displaying discovery debug logs related to Gateway discovery processes, including UI elements for viewing, copying, and formatting log entries.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays discovery debug logs with options to copy logs and shows log entries with timestamps.

methods.name: formattedLog
methods.description: Formats the entire debug log into a single string, with each entry prefixed by its ISO timestamp.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a human-readable time string (HH:mm:ss).

methods.name: formatISO
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string with fractional seconds.
